7-day event (one short task per day) + 7 days of bonus

Seasonal event (5 to 12 August) at the {wiki:Great Expedition Wharf}, near Fibula. Every day {npc:Proprietor Piers} gives a group task at the shipyard; completing it earns you Event Points and a vote for a bonus for your world. You trade the points for rubber ducks, the Captain outfit, the Landsailer mount and exploration gear.
When you trade **140 Event Points**, at any stage of the event.
Only during the event (5 to 12 August).
Fibula Tunnel (path between Thais and Fibula)
